text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, that movie was a hit!
The story, the structure, the directing—everything was top-notch!
choice_data_list: It was totally worth seeing it in an immersive theater!
It was totally worth seeing it in an immersive theater!

text_block_list.text:
This time, we watched the popular detective movie everyone's talking about.
It's famous for treating the audience as the detective's assistant.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totally. ...Man, that gave me serious chills.
That scene where they found the clue to solve the case
through the "scent" that only an immersive theater could offer!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The crime scene investigation—a floral scent suddenly drifts into the stands. Just as the thought 'What's that?' hits, the detective's sharp gaze turns to the assistant... with a smirk.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"‘I thought we were at a dead end...
but it seems even an invisible man
couldn't mask his scent.’"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“Now, partner. What did you catch a scent of?
If it's the sweet fragrance of flowers—”
choice_data_list: "Dinner at the hotel tonight, then."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha. Lookin' good, Trai-chan.
Totally sharp~.
choice_data_list: Plus, it's a really cool scene.
Plus, it's a really cool scene.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Memorable scenes really do
stick with you, don't they~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
No, but really. I never expected you
to play along so enthusiastically~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, wanna give it a try?
Reenacting famous scenes from movies we've watched together♪”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Oops... A dead end, huh? This isn't good~"
choice_data_list: Oh, 'Your life too, is a "ripper"'

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"‘Aha! You sure say some scary things!
...Buuut, you know?’"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "The one whose breath is truly stopping... is you, isn't it?"
choice_data_list: "Wh-When did you get behind me?! Gyaah!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Did somebody call for my hero!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"‘Well, well, long time no see!
Man, since I didn't hear a peep from you, 
I thought about accidentally betraying you for a second!’"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa there... It's all right. You don't have to say a word.
How many wicked deeds have we pulled off together by now?
I know everything about you. Yes, absolutely everything."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Your name is Alan. Alan Trot.
A genius of the century, a mastermind of villainy,
and a master criminal despised throughout the world."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "He orders me around, the world's greatest informant! Heading east, west, south, and north whenever an evil scheme pops into his head! Truly the worst guy who will do whatever it takes—and yet,"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Three days ago, I slipped on a banana peel, hit my head, and became the world's biggest fool who lost all his memories!"
choice_data_list: "Sorry. Yours was the only contact info I had..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "IDIUUUUUUUUT!"

Transcend puts on a magnificent performance.
Afterward, we recreated various movie scenes.
However—
(Click-clack, click-clack...)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: “――Who would've thought the toys we used to point at each other back then would end up being the real deal.”
choice_data_list: "So you've got no intention of reconsidering, right?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Don't ask me that...
...You'll just make me excited, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Alas, time is up.
When the crows cry, it is time to say goodbye."
choice_data_list: "...Let me just say this one last thing."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Hm?"
choice_data_list: "I... even now, I still love you—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list: Ah... "L-Love me..."

text_block_list.text: "I-It's no good. Because I didn't spit it out right away, it's getting harder and harder to say—"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: “—Haha. Idiot.”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "When that happens... here's what you say."
choice_data_list: (Huh!? What's that, an ad-li—)
(Huh!? What is that, an ad-li—)

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I love you, partner."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Bang.
...Just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Pukukuku! What's wrong, Trai-chan?
Did you suddenly forget your lines?"
choice_data_list: ...No! Anyone would be embarrassed by that!
...No! Anyone would be embarrassed by that, right?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh? It's just a line, a l-i-n-e.
Come on, repeat after me!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I love you, partner"?
choice_data_list: ..."I-I love you, partner."
...Ah! I'm kinda getting hungry~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Cut, cuuut!
What's the matter, Trainy? You're way too stiff!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Relax more, relaaax!
With a face oozing hatred, sorrow, and yet
an affection you just can't completely throw away...!"
choice_data_list: Man, your impression of the director is amazing, isn't it?!
Man, your impression of the director is amazing, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, both my parents are movie directors, after all~.
Though they specialize in documentaries.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Wait a sec. You think you can fool me with just that~?
...Alright, let's go for Take 2!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Ready... action!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho~? Well, well, well~?
Isn't it strange that you're hungry~?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, who was it again
that ate takoyaki from a food stall before coming here~?
choice_data_list: Ugh... It's me.
Ugh... It's me.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Who was it again that got carried away, bought extra,
got too full, and passed it off to me~~?
choice_data_list: It's me!
It's me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Confession accepted~ And that's a strike~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, blow me away with an amazing performance, okay♪
—Ready, and action!
